answer: Perfect! All 126 tests now pass. The issue was in the `bulk_discount` function at `shopcart/pricing.py:14`. The condition used `>` instead of `>=`, so the bulk discount wasn't being applied when quantity was exactly at the threshold (10 units). The docstring already stated "10% off the line when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more," so the fix aligns the code with the intended behavior.
